transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm just here because I keep messing up little things. Just... writing the wrong time down on a class sheet at the senior center, or... measuring a board and still cutting it a hair short 'cause I skipped over the small print. Just stuff like that.
Have you always had trouble with small mistakes like this since you were younger, or is this something new that's developed recently?

I guess it's... not really new. Always been like this. Even back in, uh, elementary school, my teachers used to write that I was a bright kid, but... I'd always forget my books or lose my homework. Just... staring out the window, mostly. Unless someone was right there keeping me on track. So... yeah. Always been there.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still for long periods, like during meetings or meals?

I suppose. Um... if I have to sit through a whole meeting, or... even just a quiet evening at the condo. I get a bit of that... ants-in-my-pants feeling, I guess. Just... want to get up. Check on things, or putter around. But... yeah. That's about it.
Do you often find yourself interrupting conversations or blurting things out before someone finishes speaking, or having trouble waiting your turn in line or in conversation?
No, not really. I... usually just keep to myself. I don't really mind waiting my turn, and... I'm not much of a talker anyway, so I don't really interrupt folks.
Would you say these mistakes and restlessness cause real problems for you in more than one area of your life—like at home, at work, or in your social activities?

I suppose. Um... I did step back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops recently. Just... too many mix-ups, I guess. And at home... well, my wife usually has to double-check our plans. Just to make sure I don't throw off any family visits, or... activities we have at the center. So... yeah. It gets in the way a bit.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious, worried, or down in mood recently, in a way that might be affecting your concentration or energy levels?
No. Not really. I mean... I feel alright, mostly. Just... regular, I guess. Not particularly down or worried. Just the usual.
Have you noticed any issues with your sleep quality, or do you use alcohol, caffeine, or other substances regularly that might be affecting your concentration and energy?

Sleep is fine. I get about seven or eight hours, usually. And I just drink coffee in the morning... maybe a cup or two. Nothing out of the ordinary. Don't really drink alcohol. So... no, nothing like that.

Thinking back to before you were about 12 years old, can you recall specific examples of these same kinds of mistakes or forgetfulness happening regularly, like losing homework or missing details in schoolwork?

I guess so. Um... I remember my teachers back in elementary school... they'd write on my report cards that I was bright enough, but... I was always forgetting my books. Or losing my homework. They said I'd just stare out the window a lot... unless someone was right there to keep me on track. So... yeah, it's been around a while.
